meta.title: DOGS Sampler — Royalty-Free Sample Discovery
meta.description: Search and preview royalty-free audio samples from Freesound, the Internet Archive, and Pixabay sound effects. Global sample discovery for producers, built for speed.

app.title: DOGS
app.intro: One search box, three deep crates: Freesound, the Internet Archive audio library, and Pixabay sound effects. Preview instantly, filter by duration and license, and pull the perfect sample for your next track.

features.search_desc: Query Freesound, the Internet Archive, and Pixabay sound effects from a single search — no tab-hopping between sample sites.
features.preview_desc: Stream MP3 previews right in the browser before you commit. Waveform peeks and one-tap auditioning.
features.license_desc: Every result carries its license up front — Creative Commons, public domain, or Pixabay terms — so you sample with confidence.
